_comment: secondary own-PR lane policy (my PRs only, author owner-account). Read by own_pr_merge.py --target secondary through the review engine (OPRG_POLICY). A rule hit means the PR waits for my sign-off in the Ops Center (Reviews > secondary > Approve and merge). Everything else merges on its own once green, and fixable problems start an auto-fix session. Engineer PRs are never handled here: the secondary-pr-review lane owns them and escalates to me for direction.

residual_risk_rule.title: Residual risk: a one-second race with a named recovery
residual_risk_rule.text: A review finding is auto-accepted and logged as technical debt ONLY when BOTH hold: (i) it needs a concurrent event inside the same instant (a race window of about a second or less, for example a merge landing between a main check and the apply or delete), AND (ii) a working recovery already exists and is named (Terraform refuses a stale saved plan, a deleted grant has a restore line). Everything else still goes to the owner.

examples.race: a merge landing between a main check and the apply or delete
recovery: Terraform refuses a stale saved plan
a deleted grant has a restore line

citation_required: file:line evidence for the race and for the recovery
residual_risk_rule._note: The lane still clears only the ids named in a triage marker. This rule only lets a fix session triage a high as accepted, it never widens what the lane merges.

own_pr_merge._note: Same gates as the primary lane. Approved by owner decision 2026-10-09 ().

_reuse_note: The tfplan gate matcher is prod-only. secondary has no terraform-ci workflow, so plan rules never fire here.
_inherit_note: line_rules and role_assignment_scope come from the primary policy at load time, so the IaC sign-off rules (role grants, identities, federated credentials, policy exemptions, Key Vaults) are one list for both repos.
_ignore_note: Vercel preview checks are expected and non-blocking on secondary (fork protection, per-app ignored build step). The lane never holds a PR on them.

path_rules.reason: adds or changes key or certificate material
